statements.text: In qualia transference, phenomenal property instances pass from one subject of experience to another, so that the property that leaves one subject is numerically identical with the property that appears in the other. Some aspects of a subject’s phenomenal properties can be transferred while the rest stay, leaving both subjects with a thinned-out version of the original experience.

sources.quote: In a case of qualia transference, phenomenal property instances are transferred from one subject of experience to another.
